name: singlet_statistics_post_clustering_inference
title: Post-clustering differential expression with valid p-values
description: Tests each gene for a difference between clusters whose labels were computed from the same counts, correcting for that double dipping. The default countsplit_nb splits counts under a negative binomial model; labels must be learned on fold 1 only, which the tool checks against provenance. Writes per-gene p-values (clusterde writes empirical q-values) and BH q-values per cluster contrast. naive_wilcoxon is an uncorrected benchmark baseline; do not use it for inference.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

cluster_key.description: obs column with cluster labels, learned only on fold-1 or estimation-half cells for splitting and tn_test.

method.description: Test to run. countsplit_nb is the model-based default; naive_wilcoxon is a baseline only.

alpha.description: BH false discovery rate level per contrast; also the clusterde FDR level.

seed.description: Random seed for the fold assignment and the TN split.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

epsilon.description: Share of each count given to fold 1 (clustering); the test uses the rest.

overdispersion_key.description: var column with known per-gene negative binomial size; required by countsplit_nb, ignored by countsplit_poisson.

split_prop.description: Fraction of cells used to fit the separating hyperplane.

svm_C.description: Penalty C passed to the linear SVM that fits the hyperplane.

use_tdist.description: Use a t reference with n_y+n_z-2 degrees of freedom instead of normal.

clusterde.description: Options for clusterde null generation and calibration.

null_family.description: Per-gene family for the single-population null; nb is the recommended family for UMI counts.

corr_cut.description: Correlation cutoff used by the null generator.

n_pcs.description: Number of principal components used in null generation.

n_rep.description: Number of single-population null replicates generated.

naive_wilcoxon.description: Pre-filters for the naive Wilcoxon baseline.

min_pct.description: Minimum fraction of cells expressing the gene in either group.

logfc_threshold.description: Minimum average log fold change for a gene to be tested.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. varm/post_clust_pval_countsplit_nb. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: For completed runs: method, alpha, epsilon, contrasts, genes_tested, genes_skipped_zero_variance, discoveries_q_le_alpha per contrast, provenance_check. Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
